properties.Notes: In The Runway Approach Areas Located Within The Airport Overlay District, No Structure Shall Be Of A Height Greater Than That Determined to Be Safe By Federal Aviation Regulations.

New Residential Structures Require A Public Hearing In The Special Flood Hazard Area And Are Prohibited In The Floodway. Substantial Improvement Of Existing Structures Requires A Public Hearing In The Whole District.

Manually Mapped Based On Parcel Boundaries: "The (Naso) Native American Sites Overlay District Is Defined As All Properties On Monument Road." All Development Subject to Conditional Use Review And Require Public Hearing If Allowed. The More Restrictive Standards Apply Between Base District And Overlay.
